# Third-party skills: GSAP (official)

Copied unchanged from [greensock/gsap-skills](https://github.com/greensock/gsap-skills) at commit `aed9cfd3277740755f6bfc1155c7aa645403b760` (2026-04-21), MIT License (see `LICENSE`).

| Skill              | Use in BattleQuest                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `gsap-core`        | Tweens, easing, stagger, `gsap.matchMedia()` for reduced motion                                                                      |
| `gsap-timeline`    | Sequencing: radial menu bloom, ceremonies, unlock moments                                                                            |
| `gsap-plugins`     | Flip (shared-element transitions), DrawSVG (ink lines), MorphSVG, SplitText (titles), CustomEase, PixiPlugin-style property tweening |
| `gsap-performance` | Transforms only, no layout thrashing, batching                                                                                       |
| `gsap-utils`       | snap, mapRange, interpolate (number tickers, camera)                                                                                 |

Not copied: `gsap-react`, `gsap-frameworks` (the game uses plain TypeScript), `gsap-scrolltrigger` (no scroll-driven pages).
